create_text_classification_params: create a TextClassificationParams instance with custom learning rate and epochs for training
configure_text_classification_model: configure TextClassificationParams to use a specific model name and max sequence length
set_early_stopping_params: set early stopping patience and threshold on TextClassificationParams for training
configure_batch_and_precision: configure batch size, gradient accumulation, and mixed precision on TextClassificationParams
setup_hub_push_params: setup TextClassificationParams with hub token, username, and push to hub enabled
